The subsidiary reports $8,000,000 of distributable retained earnings, so on the face of it the payment appears supportable. Before I authorize this, I need each of you — capital risk, tax, and subsidiary controllership — to report any constraints or concerns you're aware of. Please go ahead.

The test also requires monthly capital-ratio monitoring for six months after any distribution. I have not yet entered this result in the distribution worksheet, but it is conclusive — a $6,000,000 dividend would breach the post-dividend capital ratio requirement. The maximum supportable dividend under my stress test is $4,000,000.
